\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item ``Greedy stays ahead'': compare the greedy and an optimal solution step by step
    \item The exchange argument: turn an optimal solution into the greedy one without making it worse
    \item Local repairs: fix the first violation in the cheapest way
    \item Writing the proof in five lines
    \item Counter-example hunting as the other half of a proof
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Part B --- Patterns} (with the two solved problems of each pattern)

    \item \textbf{Exchange arguments} --- Minimum Increment to Make Array Unique {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 945)}, Minimum Deletions to Make Character Frequencies Unique {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1647)}
    \item \textbf{Local repairs} --- Minimum Time to Make Rope Colorful {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1578)}, Minimum Replacements to Sort the Array {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 2366)}
